players.product: MLCC dielectric ceramic powders (base and formulated barium titanate powders), incl. automotive-grade and AI-server high-end grades

quarterly_data.signal: General manager Huo Xiyun (2025 annual results briefing): helped by recovering downstream demand, and especially fast demand growth in automotive electronics and AI servers, sales volume of the company's MLCC dielectric powders keeps growing steadily; in 2026 the company is concentrating on AI-server and automotive-grade MLCC dielectric powders, whose production and sales he said are expected to grow rapidly.

Board secretary Hu Jun (2025 annual results briefing): subsidiary Guoci Saichuang supplies in volume for LED and communication RF microsystem chip packaging, and its phase-2 new plant has been completed; the plant is mainly for producing ceramic packages and for developing and mass-producing new products - ceramic substrates for optical modules, multilayer ceramic substrates for data centers, laser heat sinks and microwave capacitors.

General manager Huo Xiyun (2025 annual results briefing), asked about China's ban on dual-use items to Japan: as a major global producer of zirconia powder and blocks with an important position in dental applications, the company sees the national policy adjustment as a new market opportunity; it is watching the zirconia powder market closely and will adjust its market-expansion and pricing strategy as the market changes, actively seizing volume-growth and price-increase opportunities.

General manager Huo Xiyun (2025 annual results briefing): biomedical-materials revenue has grown relatively slowly because of industry policy changes, a strategic investment cycle and product-layout adjustments; the company is launching high-end dental restoration materials, deepening the high-end European and US markets (its high-end new products Aevra and DUO are in scaled sales) and pursuing investment and acquisitions, and he expects the segment to return to faster growth as these measures take effect.

Production footprint (2025 annual results briefing): general manager Huo Xiyun said the company's headquarters and core production base are in Dongying, Shandong, with specialised production bases in Jiangsu, Guangdong, Liaoning, Anhui, Jiangxi and other provinces; board secretary Hu Jun said each division and subsidiary sets the pace and scale of its capacity expansion from its product characteristics, customer orders and capacity utilisation.
